notes: A rental car is essential (North Shore, Kualoa); parking in Waikiki costs 40 USD a night. TheBus costs 3 USD (Pearl Harbor: 20 or 42). An Uber from the airport costs 35-45.
Summer is 28-31°C and the North Shore is calm (swimming at Waimea). June to August is crowded and humid; hurricane season runs August to October (rare).
Reservations: Diamond Head (30 days ahead), Hanauma (2 days ahead at 07:00 HST), Pearl Harbor (8 weeks ahead, 1 USD); ESTA visa waiver.
Poke 12-16, plate lunch 15, shave ice 6, malasada 2, luau 150-200 (USD); tip 18-20%, tax 4.7%. An expensive island.
Reef-safe sunscreen is required (oxybenzone banned); keep 3 m from turtles and seals, or face a fine. Aloha and mahalo.
Try Kona coffee, macadamia nuts, spam musubi (at 7-Eleven) and loco moco; look out for the Zippy's chain.

stops.name: Diamond Head State Monument
stops.tips: The crater hike is 1.3 km (steps and a tunnel); it opens at 06:00. Foreign visitors must reserve 30 days ahead, 5 USD. Go for sunrise.

stops.name: Leonard's Bakery
stops.tips: Since 1952, famous for malasada (Portuguese doughnut); eat it hot, expect a queue.

stops.name: Waikiki Beach
stops.tips: See the Duke Kahanamoku statue; take a surf lesson (75 USD) or an outrigger canoe. Kuhio Beach is calm.

stops.name: Marukame Udon Waikiki
stops.tips: Cheap, fresh udon; the queue moves fast.

stops.name: Waikiki Sunset Kapahulu Groin
stops.tips: Watch the sunset from Duke's bar or the pier; Friday fireworks at the Hilton at 19:45.

backups.name: Duke's Waikiki
backups.tips: Beach bar and hula pie; sunset views.

backups.name: Honolulu Zoo & Kapiolani Park
backups.tips: A park and zoo at the end of Waikiki; an alternative to the beach.

stops.name: Pearl Harbor National Memorial
stops.tips: The USS Arizona Memorial boat programme (recreation.gov, 1 USD) opens 8 weeks ahead at 08:00 HST and sells out. No bags allowed; take bus 20 or 42.

stops.name: USS Missouri Battleship
stops.tips: The deck where Japan surrendered; shuttle to Ford Island.

stops.name: Iolani Palace
stops.tips: The only royal palace in the US; see Queen Liliuokalani's prison room. Audio guide available.

stops.name: Chinatown Honolulu
stops.tips: Lei (flower garland) shops and the Maunakea market; The Pig and the Lady in the evening.

stops.name: Tamashiro Market
stops.tips: A pink fish market in Kalihi; try a poke (raw tuna) bowl. Cash only.

backups.name: The Pig and the Lady Chinatown
Bishop Museum
backups.tips: Hawaiian and Pacific culture: feather cloaks and a planetarium. An alternative to the palace.

stops.name: Hanauma Bay
stops.tips: Snorkel inside a crater. Book online 2 days ahead at 07:00 HST (slots vanish in seconds). Closed Monday and Tuesday, 25 USD plus 3 USD parking. Turtles and fish.

stops.name: Makapuu Lighthouse Trail
stops.tips: A paved 3 km lighthouse trail; whales (December to April) and views of Rabbit Island.

stops.name: Kalapawai Market Kailua
stops.tips: Sandwiches from Kailua's beach market, open since 1932.

stops.name: Lanikai Beach
stops.tips: One of the world's most beautiful beaches: turquoise water, the Mokulua Islands, kayak rental. Parking is hard, so walk.

stops.name: Lanikai Pillbox Hike
stops.tips: A steep 30-minute climb up Kaiwa Ridge; bunker views and sunset.

backups.name: Buzz's Lanikai
backups.tips: A steakhouse opposite the beach since 1962; Obama's favourite.

stops.name: Haleiwa Town
stops.tips: A surf town; try shave ice at Matsumoto Shave Ice (1951) and expect a queue.

stops.name: Laniakea Turtle Beach
stops.tips: Green sea turtles come ashore here; keep 3 m away. Volunteers on site.

stops.name: Giovanni's Shrimp Truck Kahuku
stops.tips: The legendary truck for garlic shrimp plates; cash only, in Kahuku.

stops.name: Waimea Bay
stops.tips: A calm turquoise bay with a jumping rock in summer; in winter, 10 m waves (Eddie Aikau), so watch only.

stops.name: Sunset Beach
stops.tips: Sunset views next to Pipeline, with surfers.

backups.name: Ted's Bakery Sunset Beach
backups.tips: Chocolate haupia (coconut) pie and plate lunch.

backups.name: Waimea Valley
backups.tips: A botanical valley with swimming at the waterfall (life jacket required); an alternative to the bay.

stops.name: Kualoa Ranch
stops.tips: The Jurassic Park valley; UTV, horse or bus film tours (book online), Kaaawa Valley, views of Chinaman's Hat.

stops.name: Kualoa Regional Park
stops.tips: A public park facing Chinaman's Hat (Mokolii); good for a picnic.

stops.name: Byodo-In Temple
stops.tips: A replica of Kyoto's Byodo-In at the foot of the Koolau mountains; bell and koi.

stops.name: Ho'omaluhia Botanical Garden
stops.tips: A free garden with views of the mountain wall; the famous road photo is not allowed (go on foot).

stops.name: Ono Seafood Kapahulu
stops.tips: The best poke in the city; shoyu ahi, cash only.

backups.name: Waiahole Poi Factory
backups.tips: Traditional Hawaiian plate (kalua pork, poi, laulau); next to Kualoa.

backups.name: Nuuanu Pali Lookout
backups.tips: Windswept cliff views and the site of the 1795 battle; a stop on the way back instead of the garden.

stops.name: Manoa Falls Trail
stops.tips: A 2.5 km rainforest walk to a 45 m waterfall; muddy, and a Lost filming location.

stops.name: Waiola Shave Ice
stops.tips: Shave ice since 1940; try the Obama Rainbow in Kapahulu.

stops.name: KCC Farmers Market
stops.tips: Saturday farmers market below Diamond Head; on other days, see the Kakaako murals (SALT).

stops.name: Ala Moana Beach Park
stops.tips: The locals' beach; calm water protected by a reef, and sunset at Magic Island.

stops.name: Luau Evening Waikiki Starlight
stops.tips: Hawaiian dance, fire knife and kalua pork; at the Hilton or Paradise Cove (Ko Olina).

backups.name: Highway Inn Kakaako
backups.tips: Hawaiian food since 1947; try laulau and pipikaula.

backups.name: Kakaako SALT Murals
backups.tips: The POW! WOW! graffiti district; an alternative to the market.

days.theme: Morning swim and a gentle goodbye

stops.name: Kaimana Beach Sans Souci
stops.tips: The quiet end of Waikiki; locals swim here, with views of Diamond Head.

stops.name: Koko Head Cafe
stops.tips: Lee Anne Wong's brunch spot in Kaimuki; try the cornflake French toast.

stops.name: Ala Moana Center
stops.tips: An open-air mall for souvenirs (Kona coffee, macadamia nuts) and Foodland poke.

stops.name: HNL Airport Taxi
stops.tips: Uber takes 25 minutes; agricultural check (no fruit), then farewell.

backups.name: Foodland Ala Moana Poke
backups.tips: Supermarket poke counter; a farewell bowl.

backups.name: Ala Moana Beach Morning
backups.tips: A long beach run; an alternative to Kaimana.
